doubts.q: Projects dropdowns row: the 'option 1' frame shows only a cursor with no menu open, while the project menu (Pin / Edit Project / Share Project / Keyboard shortcuts) appears only in 'option 2'. Do the five frames after the two options continue option 1, or are they unrelated project-page menus laid side by side?
doubts.proposedDefault: Keep option 1 as step 1 (hover trigger). Treat the next five frames as separate menu states on the project page (share picker, create-routine popover, chat row menu), mapped left to right. Option 2's open menu stays ignored.

doubts.q: Settings dropdowns row has only 'option 2a' and 'option 2b' (no option 1). Which one is the design to build?
doubts.proposedDefault: Build option 2a (the leftmost) and record 2b as ignored, in line with the 'first option only' rule.
